1.title: Trump Recalls Last Conversation With Lindsey Graham Before His Death
1.summary: In an interview on Sunday, President Trump recounted his last conversation with Senator Lindsey Graham, hours before his death. Mr. Graham sounded “perfect,” he said.

2.title: Leaders From Home and Abroad Remember Senator Lindsey Graham
2.summary: Mr. Graham’s unexpected death on Saturday prompted a wave of tributes for an outsize and often divisive figure in U.S. foreign policy.

3.title: Lindsey Graham, Republican Senator and Trump Ally, Dies From ‘Sudden Illness’
3.summary: He died from “a brief and sudden illness,” his office said. Over more than two decades in the Senate, he consistently pushed for the use of U.S. military power overseas.

4.title: US insists Strait of Hormuz is open as it exchanges strikes with Iran
4.summary: Iranian forces earlier said the Strait was closed and launched wide-ranging attacks at US allies and bases in the region.

5.title: Former Emir of Qatar Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani dies aged 74
5.summary: He took power in 1996 after staging a bloodless coup against his father, and went on to transform Qatar into the gas-rich power it is today.

6.title: Inside Herat, Where a Taliban Campaign Targets a Cosmopolitan Outpost
6.summary: Afghanistan’s leader has exerted full control over a city that once enjoyed looser social norms, even under Taliban rule.
